s.n: Ayshe's hotel meze with smoky eggplant
s.how: Char 2 eggplants directly over a gas flame or under a hot grill for 15 minutes, turning, until collapsed. Cool, scoop out the flesh and mash with 2 tbsp tahini, 1 crushed garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and salt. Spoon into a bowl with olive oil and parsley. Brush 4 flatbreads with oil mixed with 1 tsp sumac and grill 1 minute a side. Serve with 200g hummus, 150g olives and 150g feta.

Mix 100g rolled oats, 150g plain flour, 80g desiccated coconut and 120g brown sugar. Melt 125g butter with 2 tbsp golden syrup, then stir in 1 tsp bicarb dissolved in 2 tbsp boiling water so it foams. Pour into the dry mix and stir well. Roll into 16 balls, flatten slightly on lined trays, leaving room to spread, and bake at 170C for 12 to 14 minutes until golden. Cool on the trays to crisp up.

m.note: the Turkish officer who helps Joshua search
m.how: Mix 600g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp sumac, 1 tsp paprika, chopped parsley and salt. Shape onto 8 skewers and grill 8 minutes, turning. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove. Toss 3 diced tomatoes and 1 sliced red onion with parsley and lemon. Melt 30g butter with 1 tsp chilli flakes. Serve on warm flatbread with yoghurt, salad and chilli butter.

w.how: Blitz 150g pistachios and 100g walnuts with 1 tsp cinnamon until finely chopped. Brush a 20 x 30cm tin with melted butter. Layer 6 sheets filo, brushing each with butter from 150g, scatter with half the nuts, add 4 more buttered sheets, the rest of the nuts and a final 6 sheets. Cut into diamonds and bake at 170C for 40 minutes. Simmer 200g sugar, 150ml water, 3 tbsp honey and lemon juice for 5 minutes and pour over the hot baklava.

d.note: Joshua finding water, and his sons, by feel
d.how: Simmer 1L water with 2 diced apples, 60g dried apple, 2 cinnamon sticks and 4 cloves for 15 minutes. Take off the heat, add 2 black tea bags and steep 3 minutes. Strain, stir in 2 tbsp honey and a squeeze of lemon. Pour into small heatproof glasses and serve hot with a thin apple slice.
